source.title: Announcement of a new WFC Leader & WCA Treasurer (April 2020)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader and WCA Treasurer. **James Molloy** will become the new Leader of the **WCA Finance Committee** (WFC) and the **WCA Treasurer**. James was already working as a Senior Member of the WFC.

James was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Chris Wright for the work he has done for the WFC as the Leader and WCA Treasurer, and wish James Molloy best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader is already promoted. James was the only applicant we had and the candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1tGOL1cGjpDquAMhVeSrxtsd01ZRgjImP) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会负责人及财务主管任命公告（2020 年 4 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，**James Molloy** 将成为 **WCA 财务委员会**（WFC）的新负责人，并担任 **WCA 财务主管**。James 此前已担任 WFC 高级成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 James，并由现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Chris Wright 担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管期间所做的工作，祝 James Molloy 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

新负责人已正式就任。James 是这一职位的唯一申请者。有兴趣了解的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1tGOL1cGjpDquAMhVeSrxtsd01ZRgjImP)查看他的申请材料。
